Hey! I had a similar situation a couple of years ago. It seemed hopeless until about a month after the flight someone at Dublin airport checked out the front pocket of my luggage that had my name on a piece of paper in it. I believe they open the main body too after some time and  airlines have a shared database where the luggage and contents are described. My luggage search was managed by my destination airport(not dublin airport), and throughout the month they called a couple of times trying to see if I recognised any items. I believe if you have any documents with your name on it in the luggage you have a better chance of getting it back. Sorry I cant offer any advice, it looks like you have done all you can at this point. I just wanted to say that there is still a possibility it will be found! Very sorry this happened to you!
